8278.title: An empty pre-execution thread retains its pending status
8278.rootCauseOneLine: Deleting the queue row does not move lifecycle status; pending means never dispatched, and stop has no transition for that state.
8278.proposedFix: Treat pending as non-running in consumers; changing core empty-thread status requires a product/lifecycle-contract decision.
8278.caveats: State, stop, and archive behavior verified twice through real server APIs; Drafts and third-party sidebar UI not exercised. Test source is inline in the HTML report.
